description: This file defines the 'Viewpackage' class, which handles the rendering and logic for managing packages in the ModuleBuilder component of SuiteCRM. It includes methods for displaying package lists, loading package data, and generating UI buttons.

classes.name: Viewpackage
classes.description: A class extending SugarView that manages package views in SuiteCRM's ModuleBuilder, including displaying package lists and individual package details.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, including the module name and title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method that renders the package list or package details based on request parameters.

methods.name: loadModuleTypes
methods.description: Loads module types associated with the current package.

methods.name: loadPackageHelp
methods.description: Sets help context for the package, determining default or modification state.

methods.name: generatePackageButtons
methods.description: Generates UI buttons for creating a new package or selecting existing packages.
